releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.24 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* True Aspect Ratio Preview: Fixed squished/stretched screenshots in Pin Target dialog with mathematical aspect ratio fitting neither too small nor too wide
* Fullscreen Screenshot Viewer: Tapping any learned ad thumbnail opens a crisp, undistorted full preview dialog
* Quick Corner Preset Chips: Added 1-tap presets for Top-Left (170, 70), (82, 64), Top-Right (920, 65), and Bottom-Left (52, 838)
* Rewarded Ad Recognition: Added on-device detection for 'Reward granted' / 'Reward credited' pills with left close icon targeting
* Volume Button Shielding: Prevented misclassification of top-right sound mute/unmute buttons as skip targets
